arguments.summary: Credential stuffing attack detected originating from compromised internal host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), masquerading as external partner IP 10.0.5.14 via proxy. Host exhibited Cobalt Strike beaconing to C2 at 198.51.100.23, followed by lateral movement attempts. User CORP\jsmith's credentials were compromised, necessitating reset and endpoint remediation.

timeline.description: Initial outbound connection from WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) to C2 server 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS.
Suspicious rundll32 execution detected on WS-FIN-042, likely payload activation.
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike beaconing from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23.
Failed Kerberos TGT requests (Event ID 4768) initiated from WS-FIN-042, indicating credential brute-forcing.
SMB lateral movement observed from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50.
Credential stuffing alert raised on domain controller 10.0.8.200 from source IP 10.0.5.14 (NAT/proxy for WS-FIN-042).
User CORP\jsmith credentials reset and endpoint WS-FIN-042 quarantined for forensic analysis and hardening.
